_readme: No keys or RPC URLs with API keys belong in this file. 'verified' notes say how each address was checked (rpc = on-chain read on 2026-10-01; web = cited page; repo = repo test config). Omitted keys are unknown and read as address(0) by the deploy scripts; see 'todo'.
name: arbitrum

usdc.verified: rpc: symbol USDC, 6 dec; matches repo ARBITRUM_USDC (Circle native)

release.chainlinkStaleRateThresholdNote: 3600s (1h) KEPT after re-check: sized for the SLOWEST registered feed = ETH/USD, heartbeat 1755s (directory + Chainlink docs page; max observed gap 630s over 300 rounds). USDC/USD heartbeat 255s (max observed 330s). 3600 = ~2x the slowest heartbeat and ~5.7x the max observed gap. Trade-off: lower reverts valid rates; higher accepts staler prices, and Arbitrum feeds update often so a tight bound is cheap. RISK: Chainlink changed these heartbeats in April 2026, so a future heartbeat increase above ~1800s would make valuation revert (fails closed) and the threshold, being immutable per ValueInterpreter, would need a redeploy. If the team prefers headroom over tightness, 7200s is the alternative. Any later Arbitrum primitive with a heartbeat > ~1800s (e.g. a 24h feed) requires raising this before deploy.

ethUsdAggregator.observation: Heartbeat 1755s, deviation 0.05%: Chainlink directory JSON AND the Chainlink docs page for Arbitrum feeds (docs.chain.link price-feeds addresses?network=arbitrum) both say 1755; Chainlink changelog 2026-04-27 lowered heartbeat/deviation on Arbitrum ETH/USD, USDC/USD etc. 300 rounds (~7.6h) on-chain: median 60s, max 630s. A third-party guide claiming a 24h heartbeat for Arbitrum ETH/USD is contradicted by all of the above.
